items.title: Robert Lewis Interview 1959-11-10
items.q: I was going to ask, one time you say you had sort of a bad lesson, and what was the remark he made to you? ... Oh, yes. I came in. I hadn't prepared a lesson at all... He said, would you talk to me that way?

ctx.x: You mentioned it was a little piece that you'd heard from a Johnny Dodds record. Oh, yeah, Stealing Away. Well, I think of it. You mentioned this afternoon that he didn't think too much of Johnny Dodds. Was that his musicianship, or what did he say?
Well, Sidney was always Sidney, and when it came to talking about other musicians, why, of course, he had to think about himself too, the way many musicians do.
Yeah. Did he make any remarks, especially if you remember, about Dodds? Why didn't he like him so well? Maybe he couldn't read what he thought so well, or what?
